niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers clean, spacious interfaces with strong hierarchy, restrained decoration, and polished modern styling. They often favor light backgrounds with dark readable text, but will also prefer dark themes when they are cinematic, high-contrast, and visually cohesive. They like layouts with clear grouping, centered or strongly aligned composition, fewer competing elements, concise copy, and visible breathing room. They prefer simple iconography, subdued backgrounds or blur behind foreground content, rounded shapes, and primary actions that are clearly emphasized without secondary controls competing for attention.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, breathable content blocks, fewer competing elements, and reduced visual crowding over dense or tightly stacked layouts.
Prefers interfaces with clear section separation, strong alignment, obvious grouping, centered or card-based hierarchy, and content organization that makes the main focus immediately clear.
Prefers minimal decorative overlays, subdued effects, cleaner backgrounds, and less distracting chrome over dramatic, busy, or highly embellished presentation.

Prefers highly legible text, strong foreground-background contrast, and readable content presentation; usually this appears as light backgrounds with dark text, though dark themes are liked when contrast remains strong and polished.
Prefers shorter copy, fewer text lines, simplified permission or information grouping, and less explanatory detail when it can be made more concise.
Prefers softer rounded corners, pill-shaped or rounded-rectangle controls, and generally more polished, less rigid component shapes.
Prefers one clearly dominant primary action with secondary actions visually subdued, rather than multiple actions competing equally for attention.
